objective: Attribute commercial outcomes from Story Studio publications through GhostTown usage and paid Launch Blueprint revenue without double counting.

identity.attribution_id: stable journey identifier created before or at landing
identity.creative_id: Story Studio creative identity when traffic originated from a creative
identity.campaign_id: Story Studio campaign identity when known
identity.source_id: canonical Story Studio/GhostTown source identity when known

revenue_event.counting_rule: Count recognized purchase revenue once per successfully processed Stripe event/order pair. Duplicate webhook delivery must not increment revenue.
revenue_event.attribution_rule: Use persisted attribution lineage captured before checkout. Never infer a creative or publication after payment when no lineage exists.

qualified_click_definition: A non-bot landing/session arrival carrying or receiving an attribution_id and intentionally entering the GhostTown product path. Raw impressions are not qualified clicks.
privacy_and_integrity: Do not store Stripe secret keys or webhook secrets in attribution events.
Revenue and fulfillment receipts must retain order and Stripe event identity.
Publication observations do not become new creative identities.
